text: Callum Turner faces new claims over a 2024 film set dispute, the BBC has learned. Colleagues say crew were left unpaid for six weeks. Turner denies the allegations and says he has never refused to pay. A hearing is expected in January.

The Guardian has seen documents suggesting crew were left unpaid for six weeks on a Callum Turner film. A spokesperson said the production company was under review. Lawyers for the actor say he rejects the claims in full.
